messages:
Sahil: quick sync 1 follow-up to the multi-region RFC. short question: do we want a PKI-backed lease/consent handshake for tenant writes in active-active? thinking signed lease tokens at the proxy to prove control-plane consent.
Lucy: +1 on signed lease tokens. prevents accidental cross-region writes and gives us audit trail.
Devon: big question: who holds the signing key? control-plane central signer = simpler audit, edge signer = lower latency. tradeoffs?
Amanda: proposal: control-plane issues short-lived proxy certs (30s-2m). proxies use ephemeral keys to sign per-write assertions. root keys stay in KMS/HSM.
Sahil: flow idea: client -> proxy; proxy verifies tenant residency; if tenant not resident and no consent token -> reject 403. if consent supplied (compact JWS) and verified -> allow. consent tokens are short-lived and include region, tenant_id, and nonce.
Devon: what about control-plane outage? proxies can't get new certs. we need a graceful grace period: cached certs allowed for a bounded window (eg 45s) and a degradable mode.
Lucy: edge-case: partition with metros split 1 we might accept writes in both regions under soft-consent then reconcile. need sweep & compensating transactions.
Amanda: implementation steps I suggest:
- spec the header: X-Region-Consent: compact JWS (kid -> control-plane signing cert)
- control-plane: cert issuer + /mint-consent endpoint
- proxy: verification lib + local cache + backoff to control-plane
- operator: rollout with kill-switch and telemetry
(keep each piece small)
Sahil: also need authz mapping: which roles can request tenant-consent? UI/API guardrails.
Devon: metrics: consent-verify-latency_ms, consent-cache-hit_rate, consent-ttl-expiry_count, soft-accept-incidents. tag by region + tenant_tier.
Lucy: legal/ops: confirm we can persist token metadata into audit logs (no secret material 1 only kid, jti, tenant). pinging legal.
Amanda: infra notes: we'll use HSM-backed signing in prod, rotate root keys monthly, and use short-lived issuance for proxies. created INFRA-2345.
infra-bot: CI: canary started for proxy-consent-verifier in eu-west-1 (deploy dep-579-canary).
Devon: TTL/grace values to settle: propose cert_ttl=90s, token_ttl=30s, grace_window=60s; open to pushback.
Sahil: +1 on those defaults. add config knobs per cluster.
Lucy: small UX ask for operators: a per-tenant override flag for temporary migrations (residency.override_until). must require audit entry and approver id.
Amanda: timeline: spec + API review this week, control-plane PR next week, proxy lib the following. Ill post design doc here.
Sahil: risks: (1) extra verification latency on write path 1 mitigate via local cache + batch-verify, (2) accidental acceptance during long partitions 1 mitigations: periodic sweeps + compensating ops + alerts, (3) key compromise 1 mitigate via HSM + rotation + immediate revocation lists.
Devon: question: can we reuse existing X-Region-Assertion header to avoid new plumbing? propose bumping claim shape and adding `ver` field in JWT. backward compat if ver omitted.
Lucy: fine as long as proxies validate both shapes. add integration tests.
Amanda: action items: Amanda -> create INFRA-2345 with design + rollout checklist; Devon -> telemetry PR; Lucy -> legal + logging confirmation; Sahil -> operator runbook for soft-accept mode.
Sahil: thanks team. scheduling 30m follow-up Fri to lock TTLs and signer responsibilities.
Lucy: :thumbsup:
Amanda: noted, linking doc when ready.
infra-bot: canary deployment complete: proxy-consent-verifier v0.1 -> awaiting 2h perf window.
